visualCharacteristics.purpose: breadcrumb trail (Home > ancestors > current page) generated from the URL path

contentPattern.structure: not authored; scripts/scripts.js inserts it at the top of main on every page except the homepage. Ancestor path segments are title-cased and linked; the current page shows its h1 or title. Opt out with page metadata breadcrumb: off. Optional authored form: one row with links, used as the trail

reuseGuidance: Do not author. Set metadata "breadcrumb-home" to change the Home label.
